known_flaky_test.name: test_mem_guard
known_flaky_test.note: Pre-existing, unrelated (tools/membrane-kv-exact-sim, untouched by Phase 12H) test that reacts to REAL host swap pressure by design -- flakes on this shared, memory-constrained host when swap usage is genuinely elevated. Not a Phase 12H regression; documented in this project's own memory notes from prior phases too. UPDATE (second review-fix pass, re-checked live against the already-built binaries rather than reformatted from the prior stale note): this host was under even heavier memory pressure at this check (MemAvailable ~290 MiB, ~6.3 GiB of 10.1 GiB swap in use) -- test_mem_guard was observed FAILING again, consistent with its documented by-design behavior, not a new bug. All ctest_passing_current/ctest_passing_excluding_test_mem_guard counts above are reported EXCLUDING this one test; every other test in every configuration passed. Re-verify test_mem_guard in isolation once host memory is available again before treating its earlier all-green status as re-confirmed.
